source: User-supplied Hide and Seek Unity project
conversion: Original meshes merged by shared source albedo, ground-centred and scaled to estimated real-world dimensions. Eight-ray local vertex AO baked offline. Albedo capped at 1024px and encoded as opaque WebP; no KTX2 or GPU texture compression. Texture assignments resolved from Unity importer GUIDs. Geometry is static; moving traffic is driven by the game ECS, not Unity scripts. No separate asset-specific license in the supplied model folders; project README preserved in hide-and-seek-platformer-readme.txt.
